query: SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign.status, campaign.advertising_channel_type, campaign.bidding_strategy_type, campaign_budget.amount_micros, campaign.shopping_setting.merchant_id, campaign.shopping_setting.feed_label, campaign.network_settings.target_google_search, campaign.network_settings.target_search_network, campaign.network_settings.target_content_network FROM campaign WHERE campaign.status != REMOVED
